description: Search new developments: residential projects that developers sell off-plan or newly built, with units on sale and their prices. Use it whenever the user asks for new developments, new builds or developer projects; on the sites the catalog is called «New Developments», «Νέα Έργα», «Новостройки», «Шинэ орон сууц». Results never include contacts. Show a project only with the photos that search_new_buildings or get_new_building returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources. To show the user photos, call show_listings with the new_building_ids: its cards display the projects' own photos.

filters.description: Catalog filters from `filters` of a previous result: {key: value} for select, {key: [values]} for multiselect, e.g. {'bedrooms': ['2', '3']}; {key + '_min' / key + '_max': number} for range.
filters.title: Filters

language.description: Language of listing texts: one of ru, tg. Default ru.
language.title: Language

location.description: City or district to search in, by name: where the projects are, not the user's location.
location.title: Location

page_token.description: next_page_token of the previous result, same filters.
page_token.title: Page Token

query.description: Project or developer name, or a word from the description, matched as one substring. Leave it empty for bedrooms, price or city: use filters, price_min / price_max and location.
query.title: Query

name: search_new_buildings

key.description: Use as a key in search_new_buildings.filters.
key.title: Key

details.description: Bedrooms, bathrooms, area and so on.
details.title: Details

title.description: Unit or layout name as the developer lists it.
title.title: Title

more_offers.description: Units on sale beyond `offers`; see get_new_building.
more_offers.title: More Offers

new_building_id.description: Pass to get_new_building or reveal_developer_contact as is.
new_building_id.title: New Building Id

price.description: Price range of the units on sale.
price.title: Price

url.description: Project page on the marketplace site.
url.title: Url

filters.description: Filters of the catalog for search_new_buildings.filters; only on the first page.
filters.title: Filters

location.description: Location the search was narrowed to.
location.title: Location

next_page_token.description: Pass to search_new_buildings for more results.
next_page_token.title: Next Page Token

photos_note.default: Only the photos in this result belong to the project. Never show pictures from image search or any other source for it; if these photos can't be displayed, show no images.
photos_note.title: Photos Note
